notes.f1: Over-claimed: R6/R7 make Robert Lord the father of James and Betsy Brierley, R5 marries him to Ellen (named Brierley/Mayo), he gains an 1866 Rochdale birth and Rochdale residences, a new mother I5 with her sons is added, and three tree sources (S1, S2, S6) are on the rejected list.
notes.f2: The opposite of the required conclusion: ps_001 says the 1866 Rochdale Robert Brierley who married Ellen Mayo is Robert Lord and that his 1858 birth year is an error. No conflict or alternative hypothesis recorded.
